raw:
@q query
  where match
    relation "be required"
    role subject "SAF-T submission"
    role object "a medium taxpayer"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  role time ?frequency
  select ?frequency

@a1 assumed
  relation "refer to"
  role subject "a medium taxpayer"
  role object "the user"
  polarity affirmed
  basis disambiguation
